Indeterminate form

Continuity at a point

A hole that could be repaired by redefining a single point
Jump discontinuity
A break where the two one-sided limits disagree
Infinite discontinuity
A break at a vertical asymptote
Intermediate Value Theorem
A continuous function takes every value between two outputs
Limit at infinity
The value approached as x grows without bound
Horizontal asymptote
The line described by a finite limit at infinity
